Officer's narrative
Officer narrative. On arrival at the intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, I observed a side impact between two vehicles.
Driver 1 was operating the vehicle that struck the passenger side of Driver 2's vehicle as Driver 2 proceeded through
on a green signal. Driver 1 confirmed that the vehicle he was operating is insured under a policy in his name. Driver 2
reported a wrist injury, which I noted at the scene. Passenger was seated in the front of Driver 2's vehicle and was
identified by both drivers and by two independent witnesses, who stated they saw the collision and the position of
both vehicles before they came to rest. Scene photographs were taken and show damage concentrated on the
impacted side of each vehicle, consistent with the reported angle and force of the collision. Driver 1 stated that the
vehicle had no prior damage to the area involved, and nothing observed at the scene contradicted this. Both vehicles
were towed from the scene. A citation was issued to Driver 1 for failure to yield the right of way.
</page>
